substeps.caption: From where an operator stands, 0.9 m in front of the opening, eyes at 1.6 m: the bay's overhead camera, up under the header at the back of the bay, looking down over the presented tray (here tray B, the doser's).
What it covers: the Camera Module 3 Wide (blue) sees 102 x 67 degrees, the whole tray; the HQ Camera with the 16 mm lens (orange) 22.2 x 16.8 degrees, a patch about a tenth of it, for detail.
What the Wide sees: the whole presented tray and the arm working on it. Rendered from the camera's own position and aim, 102 degrees across (Raspberry Pi's figures: 102 x 67, 120 diagonal).
